package main

import (
	"errors"
	"os"

	"github.com/spf13/cobra"
	"go.flipt.io/flipt/internal/cue"
)

type validateCommand struct {
	issueExitCode int
	format        string
}

func newValidateCommand() *cobra.Command {
	v := &validateCommand{}

	cmd := &cobra.Command{
		Use:          "validate",
		Short:        "Validate a list of flipt features.yaml files",
		Run:          v.run,
		Hidden:       true,
		SilenceUsage: true,
	}

	cmd.Flags().IntVar(&v.issueExitCode, "issue-exit-code", 1, "Exit code to use when issues are found")

	cmd.Flags().StringVarP(
		&v.format,
		"format", "F",
		"text",
		"output format",
	)

	return cmd
}

func (v *validateCommand) run(cmd *cobra.Command, args []string) {
	if err := cue.ValidateFiles(os.Stdout, args, v.format); err != nil {
		if errors.Is(err, cue.ErrValidationFailed) {
			os.Exit(v.issueExitCode)
		}
		os.Exit(1)
	}
}

func TestFeaturesValidator_MultipleErrors(t *testing.T) {
	validator, err := NewFeaturesValidator()
	require.NoError(t, err)

	b := []byte("'`flags:
- ey: broken
  name: test
  nabled: true
  variants: []
  rules:
  - segment: users
    rank: 1
    distributions:
    - variant: treatment
      rollout: 110
segments: []
`)
	result, err := validator.Validate("features.yaml", b)
	require.ErrorIs(t, err, ErrValidationFailed)
	require.Len(t, result.Errors, 3)
	require.Equal(t, Error{Path: "flags.0.ey", Message: "flags.0.ey: field not allowed", Location: Location{File: "features.yaml", Line: 2, Column: 3}}, result.Errors[0])
	require.Equal(t, Error{Path: "flags.0.nabled", Message: "flags.0.nabled: field not allowed", Location: Location{File: "features.yaml", Line: 4, Column: 3}}, result.Errors[1])
	require.Equal(t, Error{Path: "flags.0.rules.0.distributions.0.rollout", Message: "flags.0.rules.0.distributions.0.rollout: invalid value 110 (out of bound <=100)", Location: Location{File: "features.yaml", Line: 11, Column: 7}}, result.Errors[2])
}

func TestValidateFiles_Formats(t *testing.T) {
	file := "fixtures/invalid.yaml"
	for _, format := range []string{"json", "text"} {
		t.Run(format, func(t *testing.T) {
			var output bytes.Buffer
			err := ValidateFiles(&output, []string{file}, format)
			require.ErrorIs(t, err, ErrValidationFailed)
			if format == "json" {
				var result Result
				require.NoError(t, json.Unmarshal(output.Bytes(), &result))
				require.Len(t, result.Errors, 1)
				require.Equal(t, "flags.0.rules.0.distributions.0.rollout", result.Errors[0].Path)
				require.Equal(t, Location{File: file, Line: 16, Column: 7}, result.Errors[0].Location)
			} else {
				require.Contains(t, output.String(), "fixtures/invalid.yaml:16:7")
				require.Contains(t, output.String(), "rollout: invalid value 110 (out of bound <=100)")
			}
		})
	}
}
EOF
